answer.reason: The verses tell one event of Araunah: David bought his threshingfloor for an altar to the LORD.

clauses.english: sold his threshingfloor and oxen to David for an altar to the LORD
clauses.quote: So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

doubts: The Chronicles verses (1CH 21, 2CH 3:1) call him Ornan and give a price of six hundred shekels of gold; I left them out and used only the Samuel account.
